Powys.fact: The first Lord Lieutenant of Powys was previously the Lord Lieutenant of Montgomeryshire. The Lord Lieutenant of Brecknockshire and Lord Lieutenant of Radnorshire were appointed as lieutenants.

Powys.subject: Indian Heritage
Powys.question: The present lord lieutenant is Shân Legge-Bourke of _____
Powys.fact: The present lord lieutenant is Shân Legge-Bourke of Crickhowell.

Powys.subject: Indian Heritage
Powys.question: From _____, Powys would be in the UK parliament constituencies of Brecon, Radnor and Cwm Tawe and Montgomeryshire and Glyndŵr, both of which extend out of the county
Powys.fact: From 2024, Powys would be in the UK parliament constituencies of Brecon, Radnor and Cwm Tawe and Montgomeryshire and Glyndŵr, both of which extend out of the county.

Powys.subject: Indian Heritage
Powys.question: From _____, it would be part of the two Senedd constituencies of Brycheiniog Tawe Nedd and Gwynedd Maldwyn
Powys.fact: From 2026, it would be part of the two Senedd constituencies of Brycheiniog Tawe Nedd and Gwynedd Maldwyn.
